newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smithfield rated hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smithfield rated hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said she initiated coverage of Smithfield Foods Inc with a hold rating.
-- In a report, she said the stock is trading at 20 times Dain's fiscal 1997 estimate of $1.65 a share and 12 times the fiscal 1998 estimate of $2.80.
-- "Smithfield Foods hasn't finished executing its value-added strategy yet, and investors will show some caution until then," Wittenburg said.
-- She added that Smithfield is using vertical integration of hog produciton, slaughter and processing to better control pork quality and consistency, and therefore to enhance margins.
-- She added Smithfield's stock price has ample room to increase, but it may not do so prior to some better industry conditions in pork.
-- "Therefore, we're playing a timing game and currently rate (Smithfield) shares hold," Wittenburg said.
